name: samsarix-field-atlas
description: A local-first interactive reference for the Samsarix coordination model.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:cli
scripts.build:cli: pnpm run build:blueprint-cli && pnpm run build:suite-cli && pnpm run build:suite-diff-cli && pnpm run build:suite-change-cli && pnpm run build:a2a-cli && pnpm run build:acceptance-cli && pnpm run build:tck-evidence-cli && pnpm run build:review-cli
scripts.validate:suite-example: pnpm blueprint:suite examples/core.suite.json --check examples/core.suite-report.json && node dist/atlas-suite.js ./examples/core.suite.json --check examples/core.suite-report.json
scripts.validate:suite-diff-example: pnpm blueprint:suite examples/core-candidate.suite.json --check examples/core-candidate.suite-report.json && pnpm blueprint:suite-diff examples/core.suite-report.json examples/core-candidate.suite-report.json --check examples/core.suite-diff.json && pnpm blueprint:suite-diff examples/core.suite-report.json examples/core-candidate.suite-report.json --format junit --check examples/core.suite-diff.junit.xml && pnpm blueprint:suite-diff examples/core.suite-report.json examples/core-candidate.suite-report.json --format markdown --check examples/core.suite-diff.md
scripts.validate:suite-change-example: pnpm blueprint:suite-change examples/core.suite-report.json examples/core-candidate.suite-report.json --plan examples/core.suite-change-plan.json --as-of 2026-08-08 --check examples/core.suite-change-review.json && pnpm blueprint:suite-change examples/core.suite-report.json examples/core-candidate.suite-report.json --plan examples/core.suite-change-plan.json --as-of 2026-08-08 --format markdown --check examples/core.suite-change-review.md
scripts.validate:a2a-example: pnpm blueprint:a2a examples/incident.blueprint.json --endpoint https://agent.example.com/a2a --agent-version 0.1.0 --security bearer --name "Incident Coordination Agent" --provider-organization "Samsarix LLC" --provider-url https://samsarix.com --strict --check examples/incident.a2a-agent-card.json
scripts.validate:review-example: pnpm blueprint:review examples/incident.a2a-acceptance.json --tck-receipt examples/incident.a2a-tck-receipt.json --profile examples/incident.a2a-review-profile.json --generated-at 2026-08-01T14:10:00.000Z --check examples/incident.a2a-review-ledger.json
scripts.validate:pages-build: pnpm run build:pages && git diff --exit-code -- docs/index.html docs/assets/field-atlas.min.js docs/assets/field-atlas.min.css docs/favicon.svg docs/og.png
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run check && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run validate:example && pnpm run validate:sarif-example && pnpm run validate:suite-example && pnpm run validate:suite-diff-example && pnpm run validate:suite-change-example && pnpm run validate:a2a-example && pnpm run validate:acceptance-example && pnpm run validate:tck-evidence-example && pnpm run validate:review-example && pnpm run build && pnpm run validate:pages-build
